header: Rows, a caption above and a source below
lead: Every value is typed into its row. The caption becomes the table's own caption element and the note becomes the source line beneath it, which is what makes the figures quotable rather than merely visible.
caption: The caption names the data set, the period and the unit
note: Source lines belong here. Use Specification Table for product attributes with no source apparatus, and Ranking List when the order of the rows is the point.

rows.title: The first column
rows.text: A row heading, marked up as one, so a screen reader can name the cell it is reading.

rows.title: The middle column
rows.text: Set right with tabular figures, because a column of numbers is compared digit by digit.

rows.title: The last column
rows.text: The remark. Optional per row, and secondary in colour so it never competes with the figure.
